properties.evidence: TODAY'S SYMPTOM. Of 23 served skills, 5 were loaded: 3 because the user typed a command or asked, 1 because the Artifact tool made it a hard precondition, 1 self-invoked. The skip pattern that observation recorded — capture/orient used, change-governing skipped — is explained by WHO INITIATED rather than by what kind of skill it is, and the pause-versus-interrupt reading proposed there was refuted: all 23 are mirrored identically and impact-check, revise-design and link-artifacts all have slash commands. ⚠️ PARTIAL: this does NOT explain the author case within that observation, where the skill was known and valued and still missed because its trigger named only the loud failure. That is a second, recognition-side cause.
